title: The Fed cuts rates
headline: A little relief. A deeper fracture.
summary: The Federal Reserve cuts its target interest rate by half a percentage point. Beneath the relief, the housing and credit systems are already under strain.
good: A policy cushion. Lower rates aim to soften the damage from disrupted credit markets and support economic growth.
bad: The cracks are real. Tighter credit threatens to deepen the housing downturn. The Fed says the economic outlook has become more uncertain.
narration: In the week of 2007-09-21, the Financials sector rose 3.1%, while the whole market moved +3.5%. Market fear was normal (VIX 19). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: Lehman Brothers collapses
headline: When the ground gave way.
summary: Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy. The mortgage crisis becomes a wider crisis of confidence, and financial stress spreads through the economy.
good: A response takes shape. Over the crisis, emergency liquidity programmes seek to keep finance functioning. These are stabilisation efforts, not an immediate recovery.
bad: Damage spreads. Financial disruption and the housing downturn feed a severe recession, affecting jobs, businesses and households.
narration: In the week of 2008-09-19, the Financials sector fell 0.3%, while the whole market moved -0.2%. Market fear was stressed (VIX 32). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: The worst week of 2008
narration: In the week of 2008-10-10, the market fell 19.9%. Market fear was crisis level (VIX 70). Sectors were moving almost in lockstep, so diversification offered little shelter.

title: The Fed expands asset purchases
headline: The first signs of a new world.
summary: The Fed expands its asset purchases, including up to $300 billion of longer-term Treasuries, to help improve credit conditions.
good: Support for lending. Additional mortgage-backed security and agency debt purchases aim to support housing and the flow of credit.
bad: Recovery is not here yet. The Fed reports continued economic contraction, job losses, shrinking wealth and tight credit.
narration: In the week of 2009-03-20, the market rose 1.0%. Market fear was crisis level (VIX 46). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: The Fed steps in
headline: An economy put on pause.
summary: As the pandemic disrupts everyday life, the Federal Reserve announces extensive measures to support market functioning and the flow of credit.
good: A financial bridge. New facilities and asset purchases aim to keep credit reaching households, employers and businesses.
bad: A human and economic shock. The pandemic causes tremendous hardship. Financial support cannot by itself resolve the health emergency.
narration: In the week of 2020-03-27, the market rose 11.8%. Market fear was crisis level (VIX 66). Sectors were moving almost in lockstep, so diversification offered little shelter.

title: Vaccine breakthrough
headline: A way back into the light.
summary: Pfizer and BioNTech announce positive interim vaccine results, opening a possible route towards controlling the pandemic.
good: Evidence of a way forward. The initial analysis reports more than 90% efficacy in participants without prior evidence of infection.
bad: Still an interim result. Safety data collection continues, authorisation is still ahead, and manufacturing and distribution remain major tasks.
narration: In the week of 2020-11-13, the Healthcare sector rose 2.6%, while the whole market moved +5.8%. Market fear was nervous (VIX 23). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: Rate-hike bear market
headline: The cost of cooling down.
summary: The Fed raises its target interest-rate range by 0.75 percentage points, to 1.50â€“1.75%, while inflation remains elevated.
good: A price-stability goal. The policy aims to bring inflation back towards 2%, protecting purchasing power over time.
bad: A difficult trade-off. Higher rates can raise financing costs. The statement also flags war-related price pressures and supply-chain disruption.
narration: In the week of 2022-06-17, the market fell 5.9%. Market fear was stressed (VIX 31). Sectors were partly moving together.

title: The AI boom lifts tech
headline: A new frontier. Uneven ground.
summary: NVIDIA reports record quarterly Data Center revenue of $4.28 billion as accelerated computing and generative AI become a major business focus.
good: A growing frontier. The company reports rising demand and plans to increase supply. Data Center revenue reaches a record.
bad: The picture is mixed. Total quarterly revenue is still down 13% year on year. Strength in one business does not mean universal growth.
narration: In the week of 2023-05-26, NVDA rose 24.6%, while the whole market moved +0.3%. Market fear was normal (VIX 18). Sectors were moving fairly independently.
